claim: Major aging and cancer mechanisms become understood
originalWording: Major aging and cancer mechanisms become understood

sources.title: The Age of Spiritual Machines — Ray Kurzweil (1999)
sources.locator: P02 Health care in 2019, first clause; lifespan clause separately K027

sourceCaveat: The original book edition has not been independently checked. See the listed source on Sources for attribution limits.

strict.criterion: The core causal, information-processing mechanisms of aging and cancer are deeply understood well enough to explain and control their progression.
strict.rationale: The 2013 Hallmarks of Aging review explicitly framed its nine hallmarks as tentative with unresolved interactions, and its 2023 update expanded the list to twelve while underscoring major open causal questions. Likewise, the 2018 Pan-Cancer Atlas classified molecular tumor subtypes without delivering complete causal mastery of cancer or aging.
changedConditions: Enforces deep causal mechanistic understanding rather than descriptive hallmark frameworks and tumor classifications

evidence.title: López-Otín et al.: The Hallmarks of Aging
evidence.note: Nine tentative mechanistic hallmarks; progress and unresolved interactions both explicit. Mechanistic insight does not establish a cure for aging.

evidence.title: NCI/TCGA: Molecular classification of 10,000 tumors
evidence.note: Pan-Cancer Atlas, 33 tumor types. Molecular classification is evidence of biological understanding, not complete causal explanation or universal treatment.

evidence.title: López-Otín et al.: Hallmarks of aging, an expanding universe
evidence.note: Expanded 12-hallmark framework. Shows progress and continued open mechanisms, not a complete model of human lifespan.

reference.criterion: Scientists understand many important genetic/cellular processes of aging and cancer; a complete causal model or cure is not required.
reference.rationale: The 2013 hallmarks framework and 2018 Pan-Cancer Atlas demonstrate substantial mechanistic and molecular understanding before 2019. Continued refinement, including 12 aging hallmarks in 2023, does not erase those real insights. The source says many processes, not all biology solved.
